2K equirectangular Radiance HDR (2048 x 1024), downloaded unmodified from
https://dl.polyhaven.org/file/ph-assets/HDRIs/hdr/2k/rooftop_day_2k.hdr

This is the environment seen outside the fab glazing. It is a captured HDRI on
purpose — the exterior is never to be rebuilt as generated geometry.
